subject.title: bug: withAllowedHostname only updates allowedHostnames, not hostnameAllowlist — breaks navigate with non-empty hostnameAllowlist

question: Should this be fixed by changing `withAllowedHostname` to grant the CDP host across both hostname fields, or by passing a separate CDP control policy into Playwright navigation/session helpers while leaving page-navigation policy unchanged?
rationale: Both fixes could unblock the user flow, but the choice defines a browser SSRF security boundary and current tests encode part of the stricter helper behavior.

options.title: Fix control-plane policy only
options.body: Keep page navigation checks strict, but ensure Playwright/CDP connection and target lookup receive the scoped CDP control policy so local control traffic cannot self-block.

options.title: Broaden the helper contract
options.body: Make `withAllowedHostname` add the CDP host to both policy fields and update tests to document that exact CDP grants override a restrictive hostname allowlist for control-plane checks.

options.title: Keep current strict behavior
options.body: Require users with `hostnameAllowlist` to explicitly include the local CDP host and update docs/tests so that operator burden is intentional.

recommendation.title: Fix control-plane policy only
recommendation.body: Keep page navigation checks strict, but ensure Playwright/CDP connection and target lookup receive the scoped CDP control policy so local control traffic cannot self-block.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the shared helper refactor and already reviewed the closely related local-CDP policy boundary.
